title: 第3章 势利眼武魂神龙第4章 神龙噬天诀
lines: “爹你怎么能这样说！
江尘可是您孙子，就算资质不佳，他这些年不一直都很孝顺您吗？”
江战脸色骤变。
“孙子？我江承志没有这种孙子！”
“那么大的声势，就觉醒出个废武魂？真是丢人现眼！”
“从今日起，原定分给江尘的每月五枚聚气丹，全部交给江明！”
江承志沉着脸道。
江战脸色越发惨白。
半个月后便要开始年末家族大比，这个时候断了江尘的丹药供应，势必会影响刚觉醒时的最佳修炼时间。
还请您网开一面，看在江战为江家立过那么多功劳的份上，不要断了丹药供应！”
常婉茹泪眼婆娑的跪了下来求道。
“爷爷，我觉得，我的武魂不是废武魂。”
“你们都看错了！”
江尘看到父母难过的样子，不禁为自己辩解道。
然而此时的江承志已经听不进去任何话了。
甚至懒得回答。
就连城主都亲自得出了结论，不是废武魂还能是什么？
虽然不知那恐怖的异象到底是怎么回事，但结果是不会骗人的。
土蜥蜴就是土蜥蜴，包装再精美也装不了神兽！
一旁的江旭见状，立刻假惺惺的道：“二弟，弟妹，你们要想开点。”
“这种结果我们谁都不愿意看到。”
“而且江尘的潜力你们也知道，这种资质使用聚气丹是没用的。”
“我们江家如今正是关键时期，倒不如优先给有需要的子弟使用。”
“至于江尘，我可以向你们保证，将来若有机会遇到炼丹大师出售洗髓丹，我会立刻拍下来送给江尘。”
“这样一来，说不定江尘还有希望在不借助武魂的情况下，走出另外一条路呢？”
听到江旭的话，江战无动于衷，只是继续向江承志哀求道：“爹！
江尘虽然是废武魂，但也能修炼到武徒巅峰！”
“他在战斗方面的天赋您是知道的，等级到了之后，为家族押镖送信都没有问题。”
“您多少给留一些吧！”
没想到，这些话，反而更加触动了江承志的怒火。
content_en:
"Dad, how can you say that!
Jiang Chen is your grandson. Even if his qualifications are not good, hasn't he always been filial to you these years? "
Jiang Zhan's expression suddenly changed.
"Grandson? I, Jiang Chengzhi, don't have such a grandson!"
"Awakening a useless martial spirit with such a huge fanfare? It's really embarrassing!"
"From today on, all the five Qi Gathering Pills that were originally allocated to Jiang Chen every month will be given to Jiang Ming!"
Jiang Chengzhi said calmly.
Jiang Zhan's face became paler.
The year-end family competition will begin in half a month. Cutting off Jiang Chen's supply of elixirs at this time will inevitably affect the best time to practice when he first awakens.
"Dad!
Please be more open-minded and don't cut off the supply of elixirs for the sake of Jiang Zhan's many contributions to the Jiang family! "
Chang Wanru knelt down with tears in her eyes and begged.
"Grandpa, I think my martial spirit is not a useless martial spirit."
"You all got it wrong!"
Jiang Chen couldn't help but defend himself when he saw his parents looking sad.
However, at this time, Jiang Chengzhi could no longer listen to anything.
Didn't even bother to answer.
Even the city lord came to the conclusion himself, what else could it be if it wasn't a useless martial spirit?
Although I don’t know what the terrifying vision is, the results will not lie.
A soil lizard is a soil lizard, no matter how exquisite the packaging is, it cannot contain the mythical beast!
When Jiang Xu saw this, he immediately said hypocritically: "Second brother, younger brother and sister, you have to be more open-minded."
"This is an outcome none of us wants to see."
"And you all know Jiang Chen's potential. It's useless to use Qi Gathering Pills with this kind of qualification."
"Our Jiang family is in a critical period now, so we might as well give it to the children in need first."
"As for Jiang Chen, I can assure you that if I have the opportunity to meet an alchemy master selling a marrow-cleansing pill in the future, I will immediately take a photo of it and give it to Jiang Chen."
"In this case, maybe Jiang Chen still has hope to find another way without resorting to martial arts?"
Hearing Jiang Xu's words, Jiang Zhan was indifferent and just continued to plead to Jiang Chengzhi: "Dad!
Although Jiang Chen has a useless martial spirit, he can still reach the peak of martial arts! "
"You know his talent in combat. Once he reaches the level, he will have no problem delivering messages to the family's bodyguards."
"You can leave some of it!"
Unexpectedly, these words triggered Jiang Chengzhi's anger even more.
"snort!
